title: Extending FAIR Principles with Observability for Trustworthy Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.29252v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) keeps data at its source, but locality alone does not make a federation trustworthy. Without sufficient observability, an aggregator cannot determine whether the client service was healthy, the local data pipeline was trustworthy, or contractual constraints were properly monitored during training. We take the position that trustworthy FL needs an evidence plane in addition to its model-update process. Each participant continuously summarizes local infrastructure, data into minimal, signed trust evidence associated with each FL round, while raw data, logs remain local. A local TinyLLM may assist in interpreting observability signals, deriving contextual evidence, and providing natural-language explanations to operators. We instantiate this vision through FAIR-O, an observability extension of FAIR principle. Rather than benchmarking FL accuracy, a three-level trust model has been proposed and a two-participant Pytho

translated_title: 通过可观测性扩展FAIR原则以实现可信联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）将数据保留在其源头，但仅靠数据的本地化并不能使联邦学习值得信赖。在缺乏足够可观测性的情况下，聚合器无法判断客户端服务是否健康、本地数据流水线是否可信，或合同约束在训练过程中是否得到妥善监控。我们的立场是：可信的联邦学习除了模型更新过程之外，还需要一个“证据平面”。每个参与者持续地将本地基础设施和数据总结为与每一轮联邦学习相关联的最小化的、经签名的信任证据，而原始数据和日志仍保留在本地。本地的TinyLLM（小型语言模型）可以协助解释可观测性信号、推导上下文证据，并向运维人员提供自然语言解释。我们通过FAIR-O实现了这一愿景，FAIR-O是FAIR原则的可观测性扩展。该方法不以基准测试联邦学习的准确率为重点，而是提出了一个三级信任模型以及一个双参与者的Python实现……
tldr: 提出FAIR-O框架，将FAIR原则扩展出可观测性维度，使每个参与者在每轮联邦学习中生成最小化的签名信任证据（可由本地TinyLLM辅助解释），在不迁移原始数据的前提下建立三级信任模型以实现可信联邦学习。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes FAIR-O, an observability extension of the FAIR principles, in which each participant generates minimal, signed trust evidence for each FL round (optionally interpreted by a local TinyLLM) to establish a three-level trust model for trustworthy federated learning without moving raw data.
